description: Asset Infrastructure - Road Section is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
